meaning:
διλογος, -ον
(δίς, λέγω),
1. in sense of διλογεῖν, -ία (Xen.), given to repetition.
2. In NT, prob. (cf. δίγλωσσος, Pro.11:13, Sir.5:9) double-tongued: 1Ti.3:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,
